name: Their Aftermath
source:
You and your best friend of eleven years, Ramona, have been through thick and thin. You were sure that you two would continue to go the distance no matter what life threw at you. One morning, the day before you're slated to hang out, you receive a text from her that changes the course of your night forever.

[From [url=https://labyrintheexe.itch.io/their-aftermath]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和你十一年来最好的朋友雷蒙娜（Ramona）经历过风雨同舟。你确信无论生活给你们带来什么，你们两个都会继续走下去。一天早上，也就是你们打算出去玩的前一天，你收到了她发来的一条短信，这永远改变了你的夜晚。

[来自[url=https://labyrintheexe.itch.io/their-aftermath]itch.io[/url]]
